name: smwmusic-deltarune-lancer
title: Deltarune - Lancer
description:
Hohoho!

This is Lancer's theme from the game "Deltarune" by Toby Fox.
Since SFXs will overwrite the percussion, I would recommend using this song in the cutscenes,titlescreen or on the overworld.

Also huge thanks to Maxodex for helping me port this!
